items.title: Expert coaching
items.body: Every class is led by a certified coach with years of competitive experience — not a personal trainer reading from a script.

items.body: Capped at 12 athletes per class so you get real coaching cues, not just a number in a crowd.

items.title: Proven programming
items.body: Our periodized programming is designed to build strength, power, and conditioning in a logical progression over 12 weeks.

items.title: Community that pushes you
items.body: Train alongside people who show up consistently and push each other. The energy in our gym is unlike anything else.

items.title: All fitness levels welcome
items.body: From complete beginner to competitive athlete — our coaches scale every movement so you train at the right intensity.

items.title: State-of-the-art facility
items.body: Over 6,000 sq ft of training space with competition-grade equipment, turf, and a dedicated striking area.

items.name: Drop-In
items.description: Try a single class, no strings

items.question: Do I need any experience to start?
items.answer: No experience needed. Our coaches scale every movement so beginners and advanced athletes train side by side safely. We recommend the 2-week trial to try a few different programs before committing.

items.question: What should I bring to my first class?
items.answer: Athletic clothes and water. We have everything else — gloves, hand wraps, and a gi are available to borrow while you're on trial. Once you join, most members get their own gear within the first month.

items.question: How often should I train?
items.answer: Most members see great results at 3–4 sessions per week. We build recovery into our programming, but our coaches will help you figure out the right schedule for your goals and recovery capacity.

items.question: Can I try multiple programs on the All-Access plan?
items.answer: Yes — that's the whole point. Many members strength train 3 days and do Muay Thai or BJJ 2 days. The programs are designed to complement each other.

items.question: Is there a contract?
items.answer: No long-term contracts. Month-to-month billing, cancel with 30 days' notice. We want you here because you love training, not because you're locked in.
